Class UserxController

java.lang.Object
at.qe.skeleton.controllers.UserxController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/userx") public class UserxController extends Object
Userx endpoints exposed by the server. This class is part of the skeleton project provided for students of the course "Software Engineering" offered by Innsbruck University.
